prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: original landscape editorial cover for the Teleprompter Pal article "Browser teleprompter or iPhone app? Start with the camera", also used as its guide-list thumbnail.
Primary request: a creator at a compact recording desk choosing how to keep a script near the camera. One anonymous adult creator, seen in three-quarter side view, seated naturally and speaking toward an upright unbranded smartphone on a simple tabletop tripod. An open laptop immediately beside the phone holds abstract horizontal script lines. The phone faces the speaker; the viewer sees its graphite back or side, not a fabricated app interface. The person, laptop and phone form one visually clear composition, readable even as a small thumbnail.
Style/medium: refined tactile editorial 3D illustration, matte graphite devices, sculpted but natural human anatomy, simple charcoal clothing, soft architectural forms and believable recording setup. Match a near-black Figtree-and-lavender website with restrained pale lilac details, soft neutral skin tones and gentle natural studio light. This is illustrative art, not a documentary photograph or product screenshot.
Scene/backdrop: quiet charcoal recording nook with a plain near-black wall, charcoal desk and soft shadows; no decorative neon or glowing halos.
Composition: wide 16:9 landscape, central subject within the middle 65 percent; comfortable crop margins, with the person's face, phone on tripod and open laptop all recognizable. One person, one phone and one laptop only, no clutter.
Constraints: no words, letters, numbers, logos, brand marks, charts, arrows, UI controls, watermarks or border. No headset, mic or extra filming equipment. Do not depict or imply voice-following software, automatic editing, an actual Teleprompter Pal app screen, or a real named person. Opaque dark background.
